boxes.text:
Attack time is the time taken for initial run-up of level from nil to peak, beginning when the key or gate is first recieved.

Sustain level is the level during the main sequence of the sound's duration, until the key is released.

Release time is the time taken for the level to decay from the sustain level to zero after the key is released.
## Provides access to global transport functions and remembers state and tempo with your patcher ##
